title: Juicing/polishing VFX
author: Enjoyooooor
selftext: I just finished juicing my new 2nd classes for Neverrest! It’s been some time since my last post here and I’ve been working hard to make my skills/spells look more appealing. I’ve got to say it’s probably my favorite part of game dev so far! I’d love to get some tips on how I can improve the VFX to be more aesthetic.

comments.author: HealthyWest6482
comments.body: cool, what stack do you use?

replies.author: Enjoyooooor
replies.body: Currently I’m using codex to gen the vfx.

replies.author: HealthyWest6482
replies.body: oh mane I just noticed you made w godot. i think a big move would be lighting/alpha around the effects and shaders if using forward+/mobile

replies.author: Enjoyooooor
replies.body: I’m using compatibility but gonna look into this im worried id leave out low end mobile users

comments.author: epictunasandwich
comments.body: Looks pretty cool, One tip is definitely use 3+ sounds for repeated actions, and use a random pitch for those sounds. Also harsh sounds in the clip were making me cringe. Visually it looks good but the sounds need some work :) Good luck!

replies.author: Enjoyooooor
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback will be looking into more sounds and did not even think about changing pitch awesome!
